author: ojiudezue
title: v5.103.94 shipped: Energy Coordinator restore no longer zeroes today's counters after a slow boot
summary: Energy Coordinator restore no longer zeroes today's counters after a slow boot
why: The EC restore ran 14 steps under one shared 15 s timeout, so one stalled step at boot skipped every later step and today's import and cost reset to zero until midnight on 2 of 19 restarts. Per-step limits stop one slow step from killing the rest, the immediate retry plus read-before-apply protects today's counters specifically, and the post-start retry recovers safe steps without overwriting live values.
implications: Shipped EC-DB-RESTORE-TIMEOUT-1 at v5.103.94; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.103.94.md (Live criteria).
revisit_trigger: Revisit if a restart still zeroes today's counters, if a restore WARNING names the same step repeatedly, or if EC setup exceeds 60 s.

refs.release_notes: Per-step restore timeouts (10 s, 45 s soft budget), immediate second try for today's counters with read-before-apply, post-start retry of retry-safe steps, power-profile save blocked while unrestored. Tier 2, reviews A/B fixed, name-diff clean.
